##### Project general facts

Horya is a coastal residential community by Reportage, conceived as a second-home destination by the sea. The master plan brings together townhouses, twin villas and chalets set among swimmable lagoons, green promenades, landscaped spaces and walkable neighbourhoods. The architecture combines stone, white rendered walls, arched openings and pergola-shaded terraces, giving the community a relaxed Mediterranean village character.

Resort-style living is at the heart of the community. Residents have access to swimmable lagoons, an aqua park, a spa and wellness centre, a clubhouse and a community centre, along with green promenades and landscaped spaces for walking and relaxing. Sports and leisure facilities include padel and tennis courts, a running track, a bike track and an outdoor fitness yard, while an entertainment zone, a food court, a mosque and dedicated kids' areas complete the daily offering.

Homes are planned for easy holiday living, with reception and dining areas, comfortable bedrooms and generous outdoor space. Ground-floor chalets open onto private gardens with small pools, upper-floor chalets enjoy terraces, and the townhouses and twin villas are arranged over several levels with gardens, rooftop terraces and car parking.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Sidi Heneish is a coastal area on the North Coast of Egypt, set along the Alexandria–Marsa Matrouh Road. The area is known for its sandy beaches, turquoise water and scenic coastal landscapes, creating a natural setting for leisure and vacation living.

The neighbourhood is surrounded by established resort communities such as Hacienda Heneish, Silversands, Almaza Bay, El Abd Resort and Marsa Baghush, which place well-known seaside destinations close by. Ras El Hekma Airport is a short drive away, El Alamein International Airport is within comfortable driving distance, and the area is connected by road to Alexandria and Cairo.

Sidi Heneish sits among established North Coast resort communities, which suits second-home buyers seeking a seaside retreat on the Mediterranean. The proximity to well-known resorts and the natural coastline adds to the attractiveness and long-term value of the area.
